active_initiatives.name: Dyson Hope Reels — Bounded Apify Competitive-Pattern Research

contract.runner_scope: Research-Director-buildable. A bounded weekly Apify scrape of a curated account list (public Instagram data only), account-relative normalization, Gemini/local pattern classification, and a weekly report written into the vault. JasonOS owns the schedule. Free-tier only until a concrete limit blocks a useful scan. Collection is implemented as an `ApifySource` behind the shared, provider-neutral `MetricsSource` interface (introduced by INI-144), emitting the normalized `MetricRecord` — NOT bespoke Apify plumbing. `ApifySource` populates only publicly-visible fields (plays, likes, comments, duration) and leaves owner-only fields (reach, saved, shares, watch time) blank, since public scraping cannot see them; those are the province of INI-144's `GraphApiSource` on the CEO's own accounts.
contract.stop_line: Public data only — no comments harvesting, no follower lists, no complete account histories, no private analytics (which public scraping cannot see anyway). Competitive research INFORMS experimentation; it never defines the Dyson Hope identity. No strategy change on the basis of a single report.

active_initiatives.name: Dyson Hope Reels — Own-Account Performance Capture + Weekly Analysis

contract.runner_scope: Engineering + Research-buildable. A local-scheduled (launchd) daily capture of the CEO's OWN Instagram professional accounts' authoritative Reel Insights via the official Meta-native Instagram API with Instagram Login, normalized to account-partitioned Obsidian-friendly snapshot CSVs plus append-only history ledgers, written atomically by a single-writer job. A weekly analysis reads the accumulated metrics in explicit priority order: skip rate first; then shares, comments, saves, and likes; then follows/unfollows when attributable to a Reel or as a separately-reported account-level metric; then all other available metrics as secondary context. The analysis enriches performance interpretation with the Reel transcript or the cross-referenced script when no transcript is available and writes retrievable vault reports with performance findings, likely reasons, and recommended experiments. JasonOS owns the schedule and OAuth token lifecycle; Meta is the first-party source of record. Initial accounts are @dysonhopemusic and @sigil.zero.records; @jasoncookdesign is a future account to add once it exists. Collection is an ApifySource's sibling — a GraphApiSource behind the same provider-neutral MetricsSource interface.
contract.stop_line: Read-only Insights capture of the CEO's OWN professional accounts — no posting, no publishing, no comment/message actions, no account mutation. The app requests only read scopes (instagram_business_basic, instagram_business_manage_insights). Metrics INFORM the CEO; they never trigger autonomous strategy or content changes. The access token is a secret and is handled as one (never in plist, logs, ticket text, or commits). No third-party scraping in this initiative's data path.
